mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to potential rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: Positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are expected due to the consistent growth in housing starts (HOUST), a leading indicator of economic activity.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 1% MoM and simultaneously, the GDP (GDPC1) growth is above 1.5% QoQ, positive S&P 500 forward returns are expected over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of instances meeting both trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: In a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in one month predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of tightening cycle instances with FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: The consistent growth in personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) ensures positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as consumer spending drives economic growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6%, positive S&P 500 forward returns are expected over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 in 1 month and UNRATE < 6%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 45% of instances meeting both trigger conditions.
